text:
kai: Team quickfire: imagine our scheduler as a flatmate. One-line bio and one petty complaint. I'll start.

kai: "Name: Scheduler Sam. Bio: Part-time conductor, full-time guilt tripper. Complaint: never respects your 'run at 3am' boundaries." :timer_clock:
nora: "Name: Token Tina. Bio: tiny but opinionated. Complaint: you break my carefully curated subword snacks." :bread::scissors:
diego: "Name: Optimizer Ollie. Bio: Sleeps once per epoch. Complaint: hates manual tuning, passive-aggressively improves your defaults." :zzz::wrench:
ellie_design: Visual idea: tiny roommates with hardware stickers. Sam wears an apron labeled 'prefetch first, ask questions later'.
infra-bot: PSA: please do not actually change schedule windows without a rollout. See `infra/runbooks/scheduler.md` for policy. :robot_face:
kai: Prompt challenge: write a 1-line passive-aggressive post-it from Scheduler Sam to the dev who keeps scheduling heavy jobs at 03:00.
nora: Post-it: "hey, I love you, but your 3am plans are why my SLA has trust issues." :heart:
diego: Post-it variant: "If you wake me up at 03:00 again I'm returning your CPU cycles as emotional labor." :laughing:
ellie_design: I'm making stickers: "I prefetch feelings" and "I respect TTLs". Which colors? neon for guilt, teal for prefetch.
kai: Emoji vote: :neon: or :teal:?
nora: :neon: for the guilt one, obvious.
diego: also small game: 'Which infra roommate are you?' 1-3 words. I'll go first: "Always retries"
ellie_design: "Leaves breadcrumbs (logs) everywhere"
infra-bot: reminder: log retention defaults to 30 days. Don't assume breadcrumbs are permanent. :file_cabinet:
kai: OK last thing: someone write a super-short Tinder-style tagline for Token Tina that includes the word 'subword'.
nora: "Token Tina: loves long contexts, secretly judges your subword habits." :sparkles:
diego: this is going in the handbook under 'Culture: we anthropomorphize infra to cope'. :coffee:
ellie_design: I'm prototyping a tiny comic strip where Scheduler Sam steals the blanket (preemption) and Token Tina hides the snacks (vocab).
kai: love it. next week: 'model karaoke night' suggestions? :microphone:
